final: WITH g AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) AS grp_avg FROM budget GROUP BY event_status), o AS (SELECT AVG(grp_avg) AS overall_avg FROM g WHERE grp_avg IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.event_status, g.grp_avg, g.grp_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM g JOIN o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE g.grp_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.event_status
